newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas-Japan Airlines codeshare plan approved.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas-Japan Airlines codeshare plan approved.

text.p: Australia's International Air Services Commission said on Thursday it had given draft approval to Qantas Airways Ltd's application to code share with Japan Airlines between Brisbane/Cairns and Tokyo.

Commission chairman Jim Bain said the approval, if confirmed, would enable Qantas to offer daily non-stop services between Brisbane and Tokyo, while continuing to offer daily services between Cairns and Tokyo.
Japan Airlines would operate most of the Brisbane flights and Qantas would operate most of the Cairns flights, Bain said in a statement. -- Canberra Bureau 61-6 273 2730
